full_judgment: “If the relief claimed by the petitioner was allowable under some other law of the country, namely, section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, then the Court of appeal below was bound to apply the same notwithstanding the mis-description of the cause title in the application.”
